configurePresets.description: The developer default. Release, as in core: several suites here are exhaustive sweeps that an unoptimised build turns into minutes.

configurePresets.name: wasm-audio
configurePresets.description: core's wasm-audio preset for this repository: exceptions and RTTI OFF, no pthreads, tests run in node. Needs emsdk on PATH ($EMSDK set by emsdk_env.sh). The tier's link-time physics comes from core's cmake/FelitronicsPolicy.cmake; this preset carries the POLICY, the same flags as core's.
